a.text: Did Greynuty succeed? Did Sona make it inside?
When all is said and done, will we really be able to live in peace here in Kazimierz?

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: Don't kid yourself.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: Think of what we had to go through.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: We had to fight wild beasts in the underground arenas, sometimes even our fellow men. We still carry the pain and scars that will never go away.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: The bosses wanted more blood and excitement, they wanted us to throw matches, and do their shady bidding outside the arena. We had no choice but to do what they wanted.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: What do you think all that was for?

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: Look at all those places outside Kawalerielki. Where do you think the Infected can go?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Where we can go...?

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: We have Oripathy, an incurable disease. We will die sooner or later, and when we do, we'll lay waste to whatever unfortunate patch of ground we collapse onto.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: We are ominous, we are uncontrollable, and we are different. We are here to be despised.

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: Do you think the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi will really allow the Infected to start a proper knightclub?

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: Is there really room for the Infected to live in Kazimierz... no... anywhere in this world?

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: And even if there were...

steps.name: Jamie
steps.text: ...what does that have to do with you?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member A
steps.text: She's not moving... Is she dead?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member B
steps.text: I sure hope so. I don't really want to fight the Infected. I mean, what if we catch it?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member B
steps.text: Go take a closer look. If she's dead, we'll need the damage control team up here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Who... are you calling dead?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: C'mon!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You dirty... Armorless! I'll... take all of you down!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You murderers... You all have Infected blood on your hands!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member A
steps.text: She still has the strength to move...?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member A
steps.text: She's bloody all over. She can barely even stand. Just give up already.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Come on... Come at me!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: None of you... are getting away... *cough*!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member B
steps.text: She's got backbone, I'll give her that. Let's show her some mercy. Finish her off.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member B
steps.text: I mean, she's going to bleed out in a few minutes. Man, Monique really knows what she's doing with those techniques.

a.text: If... If I were stronger... and faster...
Move... Dammit... Why is my vision so blurry...?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: It's okay. It'll all be over soon—
All of a sudden, the Armorless stop what they are doing.
(Footsteps).
The footsteps are heavy, not like the light footsteps of these murderers, like whomever is making them is carrying a boulder that weighs a thousand pounds.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: (Muffled conversation)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (What are they... talking about...?)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: (Muffled conversation)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (...? Why are they...?)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No... Don't go... Stay right... where you are! I can still...
Let it go, knight.
You've done very well.

steps.name: A Tourist A
steps.text: What's going on? Why is it dark all of a sudden?!

steps.name: A Tourist B
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Huh?! Is the power out all over town?! Lord, how much money are we going to owe for this?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Hey, you, the knight over there. Come help evacuate the audience!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whoa... It's pitch black outside...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Are you sure you guys aren't overdoing it, Greynuty?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The K.G.C.C.'s building has its own power source... Grr... We're almost out of time.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh? Someone's here!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee A
steps.text: Why did the power go out?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee B
steps.text: Look outside! The whole city's—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee A
steps.text: I-Is there a problem with the power plant again? Is this another Great Separation?!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee A
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Malkiewicz...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Fortunately, the spokesmen's meeting is today. The directors are all inside the Chamber building right now, safe and sound.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That's right. Follow instructions and help evacuate the crowds. Contact the Adeptus leadership. Our first and foremost priority is to make sure there isn't a lapse in public order.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Each district should have its own backup power source. Have the officers-in-charge make the necessary arrangements.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Board of Directors meeting...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No, my priority right now is to find the machine room—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Lazurite, sir!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Well, things have gotten way out of hand...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's why I said we had to be more decisive with the Infected. We can't give them an opening.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Lucky the directors summoned me here today. Who knows what could've happened to our bosses?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We'll review this series of events later.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No problem, but most of the Armorless Union... and Monique are rounding the Infected up and snuffing them out right now. It might take them some time to get back...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Very well... For the time being, please put your original mission on hold and ensure the directors' safety.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Okay, though I... no one would dare go after the Board, right?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Snuffing them out...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No... They'll be okay... I...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I gotta hurry.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Please... Please be okay, Iwona.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Where are you?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Fartooth!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Plastic...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Have you seen the others? They took out our comms—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: It's not that simple. We're in the middle of the city. If they managed to cut off our comms, that means our channels were intercepted right from the start.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: It wasn't Ashlock who took out the power either. The power plant went down before she could start her ambush. She's probably heading to where Flametail is right now.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The Armorless... They've been planning something, and they're passing the buck to the Infected—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Find the others! We're in real hot water right now!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Iwona!
Justyna finds the prideful Infected knight collapsed in a pool of blood.
Her armor is stained a gory red.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Iwona! Wake up!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: S-She's still breathing...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Szewczyk, give me a hand—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Hold on... Has someone else... been here?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The Armorless assassins don't use axes... And even if they had an axeman, these marks...

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The wall... is oozing blood?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: It's him...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Download complete.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So this is the plan for Area 0... and some sensitive information on the Armorless.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It feels weird being able to get my hands on this stuff so easily...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Now let me get out of this stinking place—Argh, my tail—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: What are you standing there for?! Hurry up and contact the National Council!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: And you! Isn't your department supposed to help evacuate the Fireblade Arena? Get moving!

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: We'll escort the spokeslady. Is she on the second floor?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Things are a mess here... Perfect.)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (I just hope I can get away without much trouble.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No way...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Did someone seriously sneak into the K.G.C.C. building during the chaos?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Did he see me—?!)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Graah...!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Owww... Where am I... Was I leaning on the door? I didn't even notice...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It's dark. Uh, is this a meeting room...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I gotta find a way out—
Sona has always felt as though she is fighting against something.
Against the Armorless Union, against the General Chamber of Commerce, against all the injustices the Infected face, and against even fate.
She has never actually doubted whether her actions are necessary.
But, right this moment, she feels a chill reaching from her head all the way to her feet, causing her to waver a little.
Indeed, this is the first time she has ever wavered.
It's as though she's just seen a tremendous ice sculpture in the middle of summer.
A call is coming in.
The ringing echoes throughout the empty room.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Flametail Knight... Sona.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I appreciate your efforts. Excellent work.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Right now, you have two options.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: 'Lazurite' Roy is standing outside the conference room you are in, as we speak.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: This is going to be a very simple transaction. You are holding two storage devices.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Hand over the one on the Armorless Union. You may keep the information on Area 0.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: That will be more than enough for you to bargain the right to a legitimate life from the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The way I see it, you have no other choice.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Get a grasp of the situation, Flametail Knight. I have nothing against the Infected, much less you.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Be it knights, merchants, or Infected, they are all narrow-minded.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Don't make an enemy of society, Infected.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The server has already been destroyed. The chip in your hand is the very last copy.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The choice is yours.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Perhaps you are thinking of smashing this telephone right now.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Then do it... if you believe that's the answer to your revolt against fate—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whoa... He figured it out, huh? That's something.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So, the Lazurite is right outside the door now. What do I do...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Which floor is this again...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This... This is way too high, isn't it—?!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley, catch me!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —What are you up to this time? Why are you up ther—Whoa—!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Owww... Good thing I used Arts to soften the impact...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Wh-Why are you looking at me like that? Alright, no more wild moves... Now let go of my tail, will you?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'm glad... you're okay.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Somebody took out the power plant before we could get to it. Whoever they are, they're using us.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No matter... We have what we need.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ta-dah!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: This...? A small little chip like this... can change our fates?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We'll just have to hope it can.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Whew... That's gotta be at least a dozen meter jump.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: And look at you, still so full of pep, Infected. Haven't had enough yet?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Hey! That getup...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You know me?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Armorless Union keeps its top levels secret from regular old knights... But...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: 'Lazurite' Roy. You're the only Lazurite assassin who hasn't been replaced in the past dozen-or-so years. There are all kinds of rumors centered around you. Of course we know you.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Really? Haha, glad to know I'm famous. It's not necessarily a good thing for an assassin to be famous, though. I mean, the Armorless Union's not like you knights. We can't cash in on our fame.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So, either you hand me the chip and walk out alive, or I kill you and take the chip myself.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Personally, I'm not very fond of fighting to the death, especially when there's no money in it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona... are you okay?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew, I'm fine. This is gonna be a tough fight, though.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We just need to stay alive.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Heh, how long has it been since the last time we fought side by side for real? Since our fight against the gloompincer?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Come on, give me more credit than that. I think I can at least put up a better fight than a gloompincer.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Good thing I have these emergency lights. I never thought they'd actually come in handy.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What's going on? Another Great Separation?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: The power's really out for the whole town! What kind of sick joke is this? How could this happen while the Major's on?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The power will be back soon... but... just who managed plunge a city that never sleeps into darkness?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Ridiculous... Just ridiculous.
